core_obligations: Use cohomology and base change to see that the pushforward of the structure sheaf is perfect and commutes with arbitrary base change, which implies that its tor amplitude is bounded below by zero (proof lines 8414-8422).

State and reduce to the claim that, after shrinking the base to an open neighbourhood of the point, the pushforward splits as the degree zero cohomology plus its truncation above zero, the latter having tor amplitude bounded below by one (proof lines 8423-8428).

Granting the claim, deduce that the degree zero cohomology is a flat and perfect module, hence finite locally free, and that its rank equals the dimension of the degree zero cohomology of the fibre, which is computed by the number of connected components of the geometrically reduced fibre (proof lines 8429-8445).

Use semicontinuity of that dimension function to see that the number of components does not increase nearby, so that after shrinking the base the rank stays the same and the fibre condition persists (proof lines 8446-8465).

Compare the algebra structure: the idempotents of the fibre extend to idempotents of the pushforward by the statement on idempotents, so the degree zero cohomology becomes a finite etale algebra whose spectrum computes the components, and the complement has the required tor amplitude, which finishes the proof (proof lines 8466-8480).
proof_roadmap: Perfectness and base change of the pushforward (proof lines 8414-8422).
The local splitting of the degree zero cohomology (proof lines 8423-8435).
Rank computation via components and semicontinuity (proof lines 8436-8465).
Identification of the degree zero cohomology with a finite etale algebra (proof lines 8466-8480).
difficulty_reason: 67 行、四段：①用 cohomology and base change 把推前 O_X 认成 perfect 且与任意基变换交换，从而 tor amplitude 从 0 起有下界；②声称（并局部化后实现）H^0 与 τ_{≥1} 的直和分解、后者 tor amplitude ≥1；③由「perfect + 平坦 ⇒ 有限局部自由」与「纤维 H^0 的维数 = 几何既约纤维的连通分支数」定出秩，再用维数函数的半连续性把条件保持到邻域；④用「纤维上的幂等元来自推前」把 H^0 认成有限 étale 代数。承重步骤（基变换、分解、分支数、幂等元）都在 span 内；9 处引用（3 同章、6 跨章）作导航桩。注：作者建议读者先读同章的 proper-flat-h0，但本卡的推演是自足写出的。
